prefs.title: Settings
prefs.section.general.help: Language and the model Studio opens.
prefs.section.compute.help: Where motions are generated: a remote GPU host over SSH, or this computer.
prefs.section.output.help: Where results are written and what happens with them.
prefs.section.generation.help: The values every new run starts from. The bench can change them for a single run.
prefs.section.tuning.help: Every parameter of the motion solver, grouped by what it changes.
prefs.section.presets.help: Named sets of tuning values, shared with the v2l command line.
prefs.section.viewer.help: How the Live2D preview starts. The controls next to the stage change only the current session.
prefs.section.agents.help: Use V2L from AI agents (MCP) and from the terminal.
prefs.section.advanced.help: Logs, caches and moving settings between computers.
prefs.lockedBy: Set by {env}. Unset the environment variable to change it here.
prefs.windowInvalid: Enter two numbers; the second must be larger than the first.
prefs.nextRun: Changes are saved immediately and apply to the next generation. A running job is not affected.
prefs.language.help: Applies immediately to the whole app, including menus and dialogs.
prefs.theme.help: System follows the macOS appearance. Applies immediately.
prefs.modelDir.help: Opened on start when no last model is available, and where Change model starts looking.
prefs.openLastModel: Open the last model on start
prefs.openLastModel.help: Studio reopens the model you used most recently.
prefs.compute.mode.help: A remote host needs only SSH on this computer. This computer needs a local V2L install with its tracking dependencies.
prefs.compute.host.help: SSH destination as user@host or an alias from ~/.ssh/config. Key-based login is required.
prefs.compute.remoteDir.help: Folder on the host where V2L is installed, relative to the home directory.
prefs.compute.test.help: Connects over SSH and checks that V2L is set up on the host.
prefs.compute.remoteOk: Connected in {ms} ms. V2L is ready on the host.
prefs.compute.remoteNotInstalled: Connected in {ms} ms, but V2L is not set up on the host yet. Press Set up host.
prefs.compute.setupRemote.help: Copies V2L to the host and installs its Python environment there. This can take several minutes the first time.
prefs.compute.setupLocal.help: Creates .venv in the v2l folder and installs V2L with its dependencies (about 1 GB).
prefs.compute.setupFailed: Setup stopped with exit code {code}. See the log above.
prefs.compute.executable.help: Empty: the v2l folder's .venv/bin/v2l if it exists, else v2l on PATH.
prefs.compute.testLocal.help: Runs v2l version to check the local install.
prefs.output.dir.help: Each result is written to its own folder named after the motion.
prefs.output.onExists.help: Refuse keeps the earlier result and asks for another name.
prefs.output.autoInstall: Save to the model folder automatically
prefs.output.autoInstall.help: Copies each finished motion into the model folder. You are asked before a motion is overwritten.
prefs.generation.preset.help: The preset selected on the bench for new runs. Your tuned values apply on top of it.
prefs.tuning.order: Order of precedence: preset < your tuned values < the values on the bench.
prefs.tuning.io.help: Analysis resolution, loop blending, breathing, curve simplification and preview size.
prefs.presets.note: User presets are stored in {dir} and work with v2l run --preset NAME.
prefs.presets.name: File name
prefs.presets.nameHelp: Letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens. Used with --preset.
prefs.presets.title: Title
prefs.presets.applied: Applied {name} to the generation defaults and tuning.
prefs.viewer.physics.help: Hair and clothing follow the motion through the model's physics.
prefs.viewer.tex4k.help: Only the preview is downscaled. The original model is not changed.
prefs.viewer.frame.help: The part of the model the preview shows first.
prefs.viewer.loop.help: Playback restarts at the end of the motion.
prefs.viewer.sync.help: Generated motions play in step with the video they came from.
prefs.camera.device.help: Used when you record with the webcam.
prefs.camera.audio.help: Records the microphone with the webcam video. V2L itself does not use audio.
prefs.agents.note: The MCP server lets agents such as Claude Code and Codex inspect models and generate motions with your current compute and output settings.
prefs.agents.checkout: No local v2l executable was found, so these commands use the launcher in the v2l folder. It needs uv or the mcp Python package.
prefs.agents.json.help: Add this to the client's MCP configuration file.
prefs.agents.cli: This run on the command line
prefs.agents.cli.help: The bench settings, preset and tuned values as one v2l run command.
prefs.agents.cliEmpty: Choose a model and a source video to see the command.
prefs.advanced.filterLog: Hide tracking library chatter in the log
prefs.advanced.filterLog.help: Hides MediaPipe and TensorFlow status lines that carry no information.
prefs.advanced.cache.help: Downscaled copies of models made for the preview. They are rebuilt when needed.
prefs.advanced.transfer.help: Move all Studio settings to another computer, or keep a copy.
prefs.advanced.reset.help: Every Studio setting returns to its default. Presets and results are kept.
prefs.about.cubism: The Live2D Cubism Core is downloaded from Live2D on first start and is covered by the Live2D Proprietary Software License.
prefs.about.diagnostics.help: Versions, OS and compute mode for a bug report. No file paths or host names are included.
section.input.label: Input
section.input.help: Which part of the video is used and how it is read.
param.input.start.label: Start
param.input.start.help: Use the clip from this time. Empty: from the beginning.
param.input.end.label: End
param.input.end.help: Use the clip up to this time. Empty: to the end.
param.input.flip.label: Mirrored source
param.input.flip.help: The video was recorded mirrored (selfie camera); flip it before tracking.
param.input.analysis_width.label: Analysis width
param.input.analysis_width.help: Wider frames are scaled down to this width before tracking. Larger is slower and rarely more accurate.
section.output.label: Motion output
section.output.help: Frame rate, fades, looping and file size of the motion.
param.output.fps.label: Frame rate
param.output.fps.help: Sampling rate of the motion curves.
param.output.fade.label: Fade in/out
param.output.fade.help: Fade-in and fade-out time written into the motion3.json.
param.output.loop.label: Seamless loop
param.output.loop.help: The motion ends where it starts and breathing completes whole cycles. Use it for idle animations.
param.output.loop_blend.label: Loop blend
param.output.loop_blend.help: With a seamless loop: how long the end eases into the first frame.
param.output.breath_period.label: Breathing period
param.output.breath_period.help: Length of one breathing cycle. With a seamless loop it is adjusted to fit whole cycles.
param.output.tolerance.label: Curve simplification
param.output.tolerance.help: Largest deviation allowed when simplifying curves, as a fraction of each parameter's range. Larger gives smaller files and less detail.
section.calibration.label: Calibration
section.calibration.help: How the rest face and the full range of each expression are estimated from the clip.
param.calibration.neutral_window.label: Rest-face window
param.calibration.neutral_window.help: Time span (relative to Start) where the face is neutral. Empty: found automatically.
param.calibration.neutral_seconds.label: Rest window length
param.calibration.neutral_seconds.help: Length of the automatically found rest window: the least expressive stretch of the clip.
param.calibration.rest_head_range.label: Rest head tolerance
param.calibration.rest_head_range.help: Head turns this far from the clip's usual pose count fully against a window being the rest face.
param.calibration.full_percentile.label: Full-expression percentile
param.calibration.full_percentile.help: For brow, eye and other non-mouth channels: the clip percentile that counts as a full expression.
param.calibration.min_span.label: Minimum span
param.calibration.min_span.help: Smallest raw span of a channel that may be stretched to a full expression.
param.calibration.max_gain.label: Maximum gain
param.calibration.max_gain.help: Upper limit on how much a weak tracker channel is amplified.
param.calibration.blink_deadzone.label: Blink dead zone
param.calibration.blink_deadzone.help: Eye closure below the first value reads as open, above the second as fully closed.
Blink = this share from the measured eye aperture plus the rest from MediaPipe's blink blendshape.
param.calibration.eye_closed_ratio.label: Closed-eye aperture
param.calibration.eye_closed_ratio.help: Eye aperture, as a fraction of the open aperture, that always reads as closed.
param.calibration.eye_wide_range.label: Wide-eye range
param.calibration.eye_wide_range.help: Aperture above the open level, as a fraction of it, that reads as fully wide.
param.calibration.jaw_full.label: Jaw fully open at
param.calibration.jaw_full.help: Jaw drop growth over the rest face (fraction) that reads as fully open.
param.calibration.lip_gap_full.label: Lips fully open at
param.calibration.lip_gap_full.help: Inner-lip gap, as a fraction of face height, that reads as fully open.
param.calibration.mouth_narrow_full.help: Mouth width decrease, as a fraction of the rest width, that reads as fully narrow (pucker).
param.calibration.mouth_wide_full.label: Mouth fully wide at
param.calibration.mouth_wide_full.help: Mouth width increase, as a fraction of the rest width, that reads as fully wide.
param.calibration.mouth_shift_full.label: Mouth fully sideways at
param.calibration.mouth_shift_full.help: Sideways mouth shift, in eye distances, that reads as fully left or right.
param.calibration.gaze_full.label: Gaze fully turned at
param.calibration.gaze_full.help: Iris offset, in half eye widths, that reads as looking fully sideways (first) and up or down (second).
section.intensity.label: Intensity
section.intensity.help: Overall strength of each group of movements.
param.intensity.head.label: Head
param.intensity.head.help: Scales head yaw, pitch and roll.
param.intensity.body.label: Body
param.intensity.body.help: Scales the shoulder roll, turn and height that drive the body angles.
param.intensity.gaze.label: Gaze
param.intensity.brows.label: Brows
param.intensity.smile.label: Smile
param.intensity.mouth_open.label: Mouth opening
param.intensity.mouth_shape.label: Mouth shape
param.intensity.mouth_shape.help: Scales width, pucker, funnel, press, shrug, roll and sideways shift.
param.intensity.cheek_tongue.label: Cheek puff and tongue
param.intensity.cheek_tongue.help: Scales cheek puff and tongue out.
section.gaps.label: Tracking gaps
section.gaps.help: What happens when the face is lost for a moment.
param.gaps.max_gap.label: Bridge gaps up to
param.gaps.max_gap.help: Tracking gaps up to this long are interpolated.
param.gaps.ramp.label: Ease to rest
param.gaps.ramp.help: Longer gaps ease the avatar to the rest pose over this time on each side.
section.expressions.label: Cheek puff and tongue
param.expressions.enabled.label: Cheek puff and tongue out
param.expressions.enabled.help: Experimental zero-shot scoring with SigLIP 2. Needs the optional torch and transformers install; skipped without them.
param.expressions.stride.label: Score every N-th frame
param.expressions.stride.help: Frames in between are interpolated. Lower is slower.
param.expressions.cheek_thresholds.label: Cheek puff thresholds
param.expressions.cheek_thresholds.help: Raw cheek-puff score mapped to 0..1 between these two values.
param.expressions.tongue_thresholds.help: Raw tongue-out score mapped to 0..1 between these two values.
section.bridge.label: Bridge
section.bridge.help: VBridger-style formulas from tracking inputs to bridge outputs.
param.bridge.preset.label: Bridge preset
param.bridge.preset.help: Built-in preset name or the path of a SnenkBridge-format JSON file.
section.style.label: Style
section.style.help: Performance style added on top of the tracked motion.
param.style.name.label: Style
param.style.name.help: cute adds a happier, livelier performance; faithful adds nothing. The settings below apply to cute only.
param.style.mouth_form_bias.label: Mouth corner lift
param.style.mouth_form_bias.help: Added to ParamMouthForm, in half-range units.
param.style.eye_smile_max.label: Eye smile
param.style.eye_smile_max.help: ParamEyeLSmile / ParamEyeRSmile at a full smile.
param.style.blush_rest.label: Blush at rest
param.style.blush_smile.label: Blush when smiling
param.style.eye_open_scale.label: Resting eye size
param.style.eye_open_scale.help: Resting eye opening is multiplied by this; blinks still close fully.
param.style.head_gain.label: Head liveliness
param.style.head_gain.help: Head angles are multiplied by this and soft-limited to the parameter range.
param.style.sparkle_param.label: Sparkle parameter
param.style.sparkle_param.help: Parameter switched on during long big smiles, if the model has it.
param.style.sparkle_smile.label: Sparkle smile level
param.style.sparkle_smile.help: Smile level that must hold to switch the sparkle on.
param.style.sparkle_hold.label: Sparkle hold
param.style.sparkle_hold.help: How long the smile must hold.
section.filtering.label: Smoothing
section.filtering.help: Zero-phase low-pass filtering per parameter group.
param.filtering.despike.label: Remove single-frame spikes
param.filtering.despike.help: 3-frame median before low-pass filtering, against tracker glitches.
param.filtering.cutoff_scale.label: Overall smoothing
param.filtering.cutoff_scale.help: Multiplies every cutoff below. Under 1 is smoother and slower, above 1 crisper and noisier. Cutoffs stay below the Nyquist limit of the frame rate.
param.filtering.head.label: Head angles
param.filtering.head.help: Low-pass cutoff for ParamAngle*. Lower is smoother and slower.
param.filtering.body.label: Body angles
param.filtering.eyeball.label: Eye balls
param.filtering.eye_open.label: Eye opening
param.filtering.eye_open.help: Low-pass cutoff for eye opening; keep it high so blinks stay crisp.
param.filtering.brows.label: Brows
param.filtering.smile.label: Smile and squint
param.filtering.smile.help: Low-pass cutoff for smile and squint parameters.
param.filtering.mouth.label: Mouth, jaw, tongue, cheek puff
param.filtering.blush.label: Blush
param.filtering.sparkle.label: Sparkle
param.filtering.sparkle.help: Low-pass cutoff for the sparkle parameter.
param.filtering.other.label: Other parameters
param.filtering.other.help: Low-pass cutoff for everything else (breathing is never filtered).
section.preview.label: Preview
param.preview.enabled.label: Render preview video
param.preview.enabled.help: Render the source next to the avatar as an MP4 after solving.
param.preview.width.label: Avatar width
param.preview.width.help: Width of the avatar half of the preview.
param.preview.height.label: Height
preset.calm.title: Calm
preset.calm.description: Smaller, smoother head and body motion for talking, reading or ASMR-style clips.
preset.default.title: Default
preset.default.description: V2L defaults: cute style, automatic rest face, standard smoothing.
preset.faithful.title: Faithful
preset.faithful.description: Only what the camera sees: no added smile, blush, eye or head styling.
preset.idle_loop.title: Idle loop
preset.idle_loop.description: A seamless idle animation: looping, whole breathing cycles and gentle smoothing.
preset.lively.title: Lively
preset.lively.description: Bigger head, body and facial movement for energetic clips.
